findings.failure_path: SKILL.md requires safety filtering followed by alternatives eliminated per unit cost, with likelihood and residual risk only as tie-breakers. The playbook instead says to choose the “cheapest and safest” probe and “test likely-and-cheap before exotic.” An agent following the reference can therefore choose a low-discrimination probe contrary to the entrypoint, while all claimed gates remain green.
findings.smallest_fix: Rewrite this paragraph to reproduce the entrypoint ordering exactly: reject unsafe probes, rank remaining probes by alternatives ruled out per unit cost, then break ties by likelihood and residual risk. Add a semantic consistency check that fails on competing orderings.

findings.failure_path: The removed Phase B list explicitly covered all “credential-bearing values.” The referenced Phase A text only says “credential-bearing variable values.” Thus the acceptance claim that every category survives verbatim is false, and persisted credential-bearing evidence not represented as a variable can fall into an ambiguous redaction gap.
findings.smallest_fix: Restore the explicit category list, or add the exact phrase “credential-bearing values” to the consolidated Phase B rule while retaining config values and the incident-store obligations.

findings.failure_path: The changed text asserts that punitive incident review demonstrably reduces reporting and hides recurring failures, but the supplied attribution evidence names only broad literature and provides no primary page or supporting excerpt for that claim. The required primary-source verification is therefore not auditable from the packet.
findings.smallest_fix: Remove the empirical claim or cite a specific primary source read this round and include a bounded supporting excerpt in attribution-evidence.md.

findings.failure_path: The hard 5000-word acceptance cannot be independently checked from the partial diff. This line omits the head count and merely refers to an unavailable check output, while the profile’s 4943 figure and pass token are untrusted claims rather than verifiable evidence.
findings.smallest_fix: Include the actual size-check output showing the tokenization rule, base count, head count of 4943, limit, and successful exit, or supply the complete entrypoint body in the bounded packet.

concern_results.conclusion: The entrypoint and playbook prescribe conflicting probe priorities, and the sanitization consolidation does not preserve every prior category verbatim.
The consolidated persistence rule narrows “credential-bearing values” to the Phase A wording “credential-bearing variable values,” leaving non-variable credential evidence ambiguously covered.
Localization fallbacks, full-range bisect recovery, active-probe reversion, and order-preserving suite reduction are addressed; no additional material failure path was found.
The claimed gates did not catch the probe-order contradiction, and the bounded packet omits independently checkable word-count output, so the hard size acceptance cannot be verified.
No routing/frontmatter change is shown, and the existing ledger anchors in the displayed hunks remain intact; no separate compatibility regression was found.
The changes are documentation and skill rules with no migration or irreversible state change; ordinary commit reversion is sufficient.
Boundary instrumentation is restricted to redacted metadata and provides telemetry/partial-evidence fallbacks; no separate operational-visibility defect was found.
